name: What types of modifications are common in a mobility-friendly bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What types of modifications are common in a mobility-friendly bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common modifications in a mobility-friendly bathroom remodel include installing a walk-in or roll-in shower with a low or zero-threshold entry and a bench, adding grab bars near the toilet and shower, and raising toilet heights. Other improvements might involve non-slip flooring, accessible sinks with clear knee space, and lever-style faucets. These changes aim to make essential personal care routines safer and more independent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common bathroom modifications include walk-in showers, grab bars, raised toilets, non-slip flooring, and accessible sinks to enhance safety and independence.
